---
name: csv-column-stats
description: Summarise the numeric columns of a local CSV file (count, mean, min, max). Use when the user asks for quick descriptive statistics of a CSV they already have on disk.
license: MIT
---

# CSV column stats

Compute simple descriptive statistics for the numeric columns of a CSV file the user points to.

## Steps

1. Ask the user for the path of the CSV file if it was not given.
2. Run `python3 scripts/column_stats.py <path-to-csv>`.
3. Show the table the script prints. Do not modify the CSV file.

## Notes

- The script reads the file only; it writes nothing and makes no network calls.
- Non-numeric columns are skipped and listed at the end.
